text: Given the home birth and lack of meconium passage, has anyone checked if the infant has a normal anal opening, or could there be an imperforate anus? Also, does the mother recall if there were any issues with the baby's bowel sounds or if the abdomen feels unusually firm to the touch?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal X-ray findings show dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, suggestive of a distal obstruction. Rectal biopsy histopathology confirms the absence of ganglion cells in the submucosa and myenteric plexus, consistent with Hirschsprung’s disease.

speaker: Doctor
